title: The Singletons and Nesuhi Ertegun: a foursome in California
summary: In California the Singletons and the Erteguns dined together, held holiday dinners and played poker; Ertegun tells people Zutty is his oldest friend.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yes, but everybody calls him that. But I never did call him Inesuki. And his wife in California calls him Nicky a lot you know? A lot of them call him Nicky.

Yes. And see in California, like he tells everybody, he tells everybody. He says, we had to see each other, talk to each other every day and we'd have dinner together. And I'd cook or MARALEE'S would cook. And we were really a foursome. And on Thanksgiving we had a dinner at their home and ever Oh Christmas they had dinner over at our home. It was an annual affair.
Yes. MARALEE'S mother and father would come.

Yes, would come too. And Ertcgan (Hertigan?) and I used to gamble together a lot. He loved to play poker and I did too. We'd go to these poker games together you know, yes. And he would pick me up and we'd play poker all night. And then play poker all night at my house whenever I'd have a party. (LAUGHTER). And we just were really, he tells everybody that Zutty's his oldest friend.
He told some cats one day, I was in the office and he said, he's my best friend, and pointed to me, you know.
Nexuhi is a very nice guy.
He sure has been nice to us. He's been wonderful oh...... Now we haven't heard from him for about ......
He got married again and he said he was going to bring his bride over but he hasn't brought her. He's in and out of town all the time.
Oh yes. Whenever I call there for some reason or other he's in Europe or he's in .... .....

Yes, and he was coming over and he talked to Zutty a long time. And Zutty had him laughing. Zutty said, man you sure have some wives, said that's one thing, you don't let one of them chicks when they bug you, you hug you. He said, boy you sure put them down. (LAUGHTER).
